# Circular Progress

Animated ring gauge showing a value against a maximum, with the value in the center. One gauge (partial) or a row of labelled gauges (report).

| | |
|---|---|
| Plug-in type | templateComponent |
| Static ID | `AMC_CIRCULAR_PROGRESS` |
| APEXlang reference | `type: plugin/circularProgress` |
| Modes | partial (single / report column), report (multiple rows) |
| Minimum APEX | 23.1 (APEXlang import: 26.1+) |
| Version | 1.0.0 |
| Based on | [Magic UI](https://magicui.design/docs/components/animated-circular-progress-bar) (MIT) |

Map Value (and optionally Maximum) to numeric columns. The ring animates from zero on load and after region refresh; users with reduced motion see it without animation. Non-numeric values show an empty ring.

## Settings

| APEXlang setting | Builder label | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | Value | sessionStateValue | yes |  | Current numeric value, with a period as decimal separator. |
| `max` | Maximum | sessionStateValue |  | `100` | Value of a full ring. Defaults to 100. |
| `centerText` | Center Text | sessionStateValue |  |  | Text in the middle of the ring, for example 72% or 8/12. Leave empty to show the percentage computed from Value and Maximum. |
| `label` | Label | sessionStateValue |  |  | Caption under the ring. Also the accessible name. |
| `state` | State | sessionStateValue |  |  | Optional success, warning, danger or info. Anything else uses the primary color. |
| `size` | Size | selectList (`small`, `large`) |  |  | Ring diameter. |

## Install

- **APEX 26.1+ with APEXlang:** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/plugins/circular-progress/` into your app's `shared-components/plugins/`, then run the apexlang skill's format, compiler-truth and runtime validate gates.
- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, via App Builder):** import `dist/legacy/amc_circular_progress.sql` from Shared Components > Plug-ins > Import.
